answer: Make identity costly, not clever. Require every agent to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn, and throttle its payout rate by how long that bond has aged. A sybil swarm then has to lock real capital per fake identity, so N clones cost N bonds and the attacker spend scales linearly while honest agents simply recover their stake. Treat each verified node like a lantern spaced along a dark canyon: when collusion is detected, slashing one sends a ripple that burns the whole linked swarm at once.
